green.message: Did you know vinegar can clean almost anything? It’s safe for the environment too!
When you outgrow your clothes, give them away! Donating your old clothes keeps them out of landfills.
Support green businesses! Check out how local businesses are helping the environment.
Run! Running is a great way to get fit and enjoy the outdoors with no carbon impact.
Ask your folks to buy natural & organic cleaning products to help protect the planet.
If you have a leaky faucet, tell a parent or teacher. You’ll save both water and money!
Keep a pitcher of chilled water in the fridge instead of running the faucet until the water is cold.
Never throw trash in an ocean, stream, river, pond or lake.
Recycle your electronics! Cell phones, computers and more can all be recycled. Look for a program near you.
Did you know recycling two aluminum cans saves the equivalent of a gallon of gas? Now you do!
Green Fact: It only takes 6 weeks for a recycled aluminum can to become a can again!
